integrity: The full Gram-spectrum reduction, root ordering, monotonicity, and asymptotic are proved analytically. The checker only replays finite cases and is not used as evidence for the universal claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(E_m=(\mathbb Z_m\times\{0\})\cup\{(0,1)\}\).
For odd moduli the exact values are represented by distinguished roots of an explicit cubic.
Unindexed or differently phrased literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Riesz ratio of the subgroup-plus-one-point family
